mapper.sql: SELECT c.correction_id, c.batch_no, o.order_id AS receipt_id, o.reference_id AS purchase_order_id, o.warehouse_id, l.seller_sku, c.quantity, c.reason, c.original_inspection_id, c.original_inspection, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.released_by, c.released_at, c.reversed_quantity, c.direct_pending_quantity, c.excluded_missing_quantity, c.withdrawn_by, c.withdrawn_at, c.good_quantity, c.defective_quantity, c.inspected_by, c.inspected_at FROM wms_quality_correction c JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = c.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT batch_no FROM wms_quality_correction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_quality_correction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch} AND inspected_at IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET quantity = quantity - #{missing}, excluded_missing_quantity = excluded_missing_quantity + #{missing} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch} AND inspected_at IS NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.short_pick_id FROM wms_short_pick s JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND a.allocation_id = s.allocation_id JOIN wms_quality_correction c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.batch_no = a.batch_no WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.correction_id = #{id} AND s.reported_at <= c.created_at AND (s.confirmed_at IS NULL OR s.confirmed_at >= c.created_at) ORDER BY s.reported_at, s.short_pick_id

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_outbound_allocation a JOIN wms_quality_correction c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.batch_no = a.batch_no AND c.inspected_at IS NULL WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND a.outbound_id = #{outbound} AND a.planned_quantity - a.short_quantity - a.cancelled_quantity > COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pp.quantity) FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_actual_pick k ON k.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND k.request_id = pp.pick_id JOIN wms_outbound_package p ON p.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND p.package_id = pp.package_id WHERE k.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND k.allocation_id = a.allocation_id AND p.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0))
SELECT DISTINCT outbound_id FROM wms_outbound_allocation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch} ORDER BY outbound_id

SELECT a.allocation_id, a.outbound_id, a.line_id, a.sales_line_id, a.seller_sku, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, o.order_id, o.reference_id, a.planned_quantity, a.picked_quantity, a.short_quantity, a.cancelled_quantity FROM wms_outbound_allocation a JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.location_id = a.location_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = a.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND a.batch_no = #{batch} ORDER BY a.outbound_id, a.allocation_id

SELECT k.request_id, k.outbound_id, k.allocation_id, a.line_id, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, k.quantity, k.returned_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pp.quantity) FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_outbound_package op ON op.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND op.package_id = pp.package_id WHERE pp.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND pp.pick_id = k.request_id AND op.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) AS shipped_quantity FROM wms_actual_pick k JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND a.allocation_id = k.allocation_id JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.location_id = a.location_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND a.batch_no = #{batch} ORDER BY k.outbound_id, k.request_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_actual_pick SET returned_quantity = returned_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = #{pick}
UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET picked_quantity = picked_quantity - #{quantity}, cancelled_quantity = cancelled_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND allocation_id = #{allocation}
UPDATE wms_outbound_order_line SET picked_quantity = picked_quantity - #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND line_id = #{line}

UPDATE wms_outbound_package p SET status = 'CANCELLED', remark = '质检更正撤拣，原包裹作废', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND p.status != 'SHIPPED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp WHERE pp.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND pp.package_id = p.package_id AND pp.pick_id = #{pick})
UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET direct_pending_quantity = direct_pending_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET cancelled_quantity = cancelled_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND allocation_id = #{allocation}
UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET released_by = #{operator}, released_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS reserved, COALESCE(SUM(b.picked_quantity), 0) AS picked, COALESCE(SUM(b.review_quantity), 0) AS review, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity - b.review_quantity), 0) AS available FROM wms_batch_location_balance b JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND p.location_id = b.location_id WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND b.batch_no = #{batch} AND p.purpose = 'GOOD'

SELECT t.transaction_id, t.target_location_id AS location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, t.quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM wms_quality_correction_movement m WHERE m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND m.original_operation_id = t.transaction_id AND m.movement_type = 'PUTAWAY_REVERSE'), 0) AS reversed_quantity FROM wms_inventory_transaction t JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND p.location_id = t.target_location_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND t.batch_no = #{batch} AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_PUTAWAY' ORDER BY t.created_at, t.transaction_id

SELECT request_id, correction_id, original_operation_id, movement_type, quantity, location_id, operator_id, created_at FROM wms_quality_correction_movement WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = #{request}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_quality_correction_movement(tenant_id, request_id, correction_id, original_operation_id, movement_type, quantity, location_id, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{m.requestId}, #{id}, #{m.originalOperationId}, #{m.movementType}, #{m.quantity}, #{m.locationId}, #{m.operatorId}, #{m.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET putaway_quantity = putaway_quantity - #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch}
UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET reversed_quantity = reversed_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET good_quantity = good_quantity - #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch}
UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET withdrawn_by = #{operator}, withdrawn_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
UPDATE wms_quality_correction SET good_quantity = #{good}, defective_quantity = #{defective}, inspected_by = #{operator}, inspected_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND correction_id = #{id}
UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET good_quantity = good_quantity + #{good}, defective_quantity = defective_quantity + #{defective} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND batch_no = #{batch}
